compute.note: GPU-hours = train_seconds + eval_seconds from run.json over 2342 finished runs (1926 on GPU); ASSUMED 300 W per RTX A6000 for the whole run time and 0.4 kg CO2e/kWh grid intensity; excludes host, cooling, idle boxes, the open-teacher pass, serving and API calls; cost at the measured USD 0.366 per A6000-hour (D27), run time only

label_source.note: gap = gold - teacher-label cell (seed means, paired CI over the same item resamples); exchange: gold-equivalent N from q(N) = a - b N^-c fitted to the gold seed-mean curve

meta.note: mean = seed mean on the full eval set; lo/hi = percentile CI over item resamples of the seed mean; sd = seed SD; k = seeds
